baseline_source: origin main fetched 2026-10-22; user superseded missing 2026-10-21 reports

gates.memory: constant bytes per active peer and iface only; no per-service allocation
gates.correctness: unchanged existing assertions; no stalls; full EventOnly 21/21
gates.gating: serve_zero decreases; all space-opening event regressions pass
gates.fairness: worst light-user P99 and maximum pending-data service gap decrease in locally constrained cases
gates.local_constraint: sink_full/runs or round_budget_exhausted/runs >= 0.01; otherwise no scheduler benefit attribution
gates.uncertainty: paired 95% Student-t CI (n=6, t=2.571); interval crossing zero or within per-case A/A max absolute paired delta => no attributable change; lack of evidence does not pass 1% non-inferiority
gates.timeouts: retain all flows/users/planned RR rounds; incomplete latency right-censored at horizon and mark failed; no promotion on failures

sampling.cpu_affinity: first allowed CPU; immutable binary hash checked each run

fairness_parameters.congested: bounded local egress sink plus 256KiB default round budget

l0.bulk_and_rr_start: bulk at 0; RR at 10ms; peer-count arms each peer sends 64KiB

comparisons: step0 vs step1 (separate immutable binaries; step1 has no production toggle)
off vs each enabled mode (same binary)
scope: L0 virtual protocol/link; CPU includes simulator/validation; L1 TUN and L2 WG are not run and required for deployment
